title: Social Media Strategist | Content Creator | Performance Marketer
description:
**Location:** Kanhashantivanam  
**Experience:** 3–6 years

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, data\-driven and results\-oriented **Social Media Strategist, Content Creator \& Performance Marketer** to lead our digital presence across social media platforms.

The ideal candidate should be able to combine **strong strategic thinking, compelling content creation and performance marketing expertise** to build brand awareness, grow communities and deliver measurable business results.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Social Media Strategy**

* Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies aligned with overall brand and business objectives.
* Manage content strategy across **Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and other relevant platforms**.
* Develop monthly content calendars and platform\-specific strategies.
* Identify emerging trends, formats, creators and opportunities relevant to the brand.
* Drive follower growth, engagement, reach and community building.
* Monitor competitors and industry trends and translate insights into actionable ideas.
* Develop strategies around campaigns, launches, events and important brand moments.

**2\. Content Creation**

* Ideate and develop engaging content across **Reels, videos, carousels, static posts, stories, blogs and other digital formats**.
* Write compelling captions, scripts, hooks, headlines and campaign copy.
* Conceptualise short\-form video and Reel ideas based on current trends and brand objectives.
* Work closely with designers, videographers, photographers and agencies to execute content.
* Participate in shoots and provide creative direction wherever required.
* Develop content that balances **brand storytelling, education, engagement, trends and conversion**.
* Repurpose long\-form content into platform\-specific social media assets.

**3\. Performance Marketing**

* Plan, execute and optimise paid campaigns across **Meta, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms**.
* Develop audience targeting, campaign structures, creatives and media plans.
* Manage budgets and optimise campaigns for reach, engagement, leads, conversions and other defined KPIs.
* Conduct A/B testing of creatives, audiences, messaging and landing pages.
* Analyse campaign performance and continuously improve **CPC, CPM, CTR, CPL, CPA and ROAS**.
* Work with creative teams to develop high\-performing ad creatives.
* Track campaign performance and provide regular reports with actionable insights.

**4\. Analytics \& Reporting**

* Monitor social media and paid\-media performance on a regular basis.
* Track key metrics including **reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, video views, website traffic, leads and conversions**.
* Prepare monthly performance reports and identify trends and opportunities.
* Use insights from analytics to improve future content and campaigns.
* Establish clear KPIs for individual campaigns and ongoing social media activity.

**5\. Influencer \& UGC Marketing**

* Identify and collaborate with relevant influencers, creators and brand advocates.
* Develop influencer and UGC campaigns to increase reach, credibility and engagement.
* Create briefs for creators and manage campaign execution.
* Track influencer/UGC performance and ROI.
* Integrate **UGC, offline events and on\-ground activations** into the digital strategy where relevant.

**Required Skills**

* Strong understanding of **social media platforms, algorithms and content formats**.
* Excellent content ideation and storytelling skills.
* Strong copywriting and communication skills.
* Hands\-on experience with **Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads**.
* Understanding of social media analytics and performance marketing metrics.
* Ability to interpret data and convert insights into actionable strategies.
* Strong understanding of short\-form video and Reels.
* Experience with content calendars and campaign planning.
* Basic understanding of SEO, Google Analytics/GA4 and conversion tracking.
* Strong project management and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as with creative and marketing teams.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Social media reach and engagement
* Follower/community growth
* Content performance and video views
* Website traffic generated through social media
* Lead generation and conversion
* Cost per lead / acquisition
* Paid media ROI / ROAS
* Campaign performance
* Influencer/UGC performance
* Overall improvement in digital brand visibility

title: GFCC Detect/Report Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Welcome to JP Morgan Chase. Are you a compliance specialist, passionate about risk mitigation and safeguarding the financial institutions and customers from the financial crime ? You have found the right team.


As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real\-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best\-in\-class.


The GFCC Alert Triage position is part of the firm's India AML Alert Triage team within AML Investigations. The Triage team dispositions alerts consistent with the Global AML Standards, provides an initial assessment of potential Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing as well as other nefarious activity and recommends alerts for escalation and further review or closure as false positives


Responsibilities:


* Collect and document data, including: alerting activity, account information, transactional data, KYC information, politically exposed person (PEP) status, adverse media as well as counterparty and any other required information to assist in the investigation
* Review and analyze underlying data gathered opposite Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Terrorist Financing (TF), Human Trafficking and other red flags to assess whether the alert should be recommended for escalation or to be closed with no further action
* Fully document all alerts, including supporting data, analysis as well as escalation or close recommendation rationale within the case management system in a timely manner and consistent with the firm's quality standards
* Build relationships with AML Investigations units and effectively communicate and transfer information for case investigations
* Collaborate with India and US colleagues to share processing and AML knowledge to enhance AML Investigation process flows
* Process work items in the order of priority and aligned with SLA priorities. Escalate issues in a timely manner and demonstrate courage and integrity by doing the right thing all the time.
* In conjunction with manager and consistent with overall department objectives, establish and execute on annual development goals. You would participate in special projects, quality improvement initiatives and other similar exercises


Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Qualified graduate with minimum of 6 years' of relevant experience in Global Financial Crime Compliance
* Familiarity with the firm's internal systems and processes or similar processes at other institutions, and proficiency in MS Office (Outlook/Word/Excel/PowerPoint)
* You are a self\-starter, capable of working under minimum supervision, able to multi\-task and meet deadlines in high\-pressure environment

Build and run a consistent launch process for new products and meaningful feature releases.

Build a reliable way to turn strong customer outcomes into proof.

Create the frameworks, templates and working rhythms that help the PMM team do consistently good work.

You’ve spent enough time with reps and deals to know that useful enablement comes from the conversations they’re having this week.**You can coach other product marketers.**

* Experience mentoring, coaching or managing product marketers

title: Sales & Marketing Operations Executive
description:
**Sales \& Marketing Operations Executive**
===========================================


**Address:** Somajiguda, Hyd


**Role Purpose**
----------------


To manage the backend engine of sales and marketing by ensuring enquiry tracking, quotation preparation, customer follow\-ups, documentation, coordination with internal departments, agency coordination, order\-status communication, and customer experience follow\-through.


This is not a hardcore marketing strategy role. This is an execution, coordination, follow\-up, CRM, and documentation role.


**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------


* **Experience:** 2–5 years
* **Qualification:** Graduate
* **Background:** Sales coordination, customer support, back\-office sales, CRM, order processing, commercial coordination, or operations support
* **Skills:** Excellent follow\-up, Excel/CRM discipline, email writing, coordination, documentation, and ownership
* **Age:** Flexible. Do not restrict unnecessarily to 28–35 unless there is a strong reason.
**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **A. Enquiry \& Lead Coordination**


* Maintain a live enquiry tracker with source, customer name, requirement, status, next follow\-up date, quotation status, expected order value, and responsible sales person.
* Send brochures, data sheets, company profiles, product details, catalogues, and introductory emailers to prospects as per approved templates.
* Maintain a proper follow\-up sequence for every enquiry so that no lead is forgotten.
* Coordinate with the sales team to understand whether the enquiry is hot, warm, cold, closed, lost, or needs senior intervention.

### **B. Quotation \& Sales Documentation**


* Prepare and send quotations based on approved pricing, formats, terms, and inputs from the sales/commercial team.
* Prepare proforma invoices wherever required.
* Check customer purchase orders against company sales policy, approved price, delivery terms, payment terms, taxes, freight, and other commercial conditions.
* Escalate any mismatch in PO terms to the senior sales/commercial team before order processing.
* Maintain records of quotations sent, revised quotes, approvals, purchase orders, proforma invoices, and order confirmations.

### **C. Customer Follow\-Up / Keeping in Touch (KIT) System**


* Follow up with customers for pending quotations, expected order confirmation, advance payment, dispatch clearance, inspection dates, and documentation.
* Use a defined KIT strategy , Keep In Touch sequence , for structured customer communication.
* Send polite reminder emails, WhatsApp messages, and call follow\-ups as per approved scripts.
* Escalate delayed or high\-value follow\-ups to the relevant salesperson or senior manager.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates without depending only on sales representatives.

### **D. Sales Backend \& Commercial Coordination**


* Coordinate with sales representatives for customer updates, pending documents, order status, and follow\-up remarks.
* Coordinate with the commercial department for order processing, production plan review, dispatch clearance, invoices, and payment documents.
* Coordinate with the factory/production team for material readiness, inspection status, dispatch planning, and expected timelines.
* Coordinate with transporters for vehicle placement, LR details, dispatch acknowledgements, and delivery confirmation.
* Generate or coordinate sale invoices where applicable.

### **E. Customer Experience \& Completion Documentation**


* Send order completion reports to customers after supply.
* Obtain completion certificates from customers for company records.
* Track customer complaints, delays, missing documents, delayed dispatches, and unresolved issues.
* Maintain a customer experience tracker showing whether the customer had a smooth, delayed, problematic, or escalated experience.
* Share recurring customer issues with management for process improvement.

### **F. Agency \& Marketing Collateral Coordination**


* Coordinate with marketing agencies/freelancers for brochures, datasheets, catalogues, emailers, LinkedIn creatives, and other collaterals.
* Collect inputs from sales/product/management and convert them into clear agency briefs.
* Maintain updated folders of final approved marketing material.
* Ensure the sales team has access to the latest brochures, presentations, company profile, product sheets, and email templates.
* Track agency deliverables, deadlines, approvals, and revisions.

### **G. Records, CRM \& MIS**


* Maintain customer\-wise files containing enquiry history, quotations, PO, PI, correspondence, dispatch details, invoices, payment status, completion certificate, and complaints.
* Update CRM/Excel/ERP daily.
* Prepare weekly MIS on enquiries, quotes sent, follow\-ups due, orders received, pending advances, dispatches, completion certificates pending, and payments pending.
* Share ageing reports for pending quotations, pending customer approvals, pending payments, and pending documents.
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------


* Number of enquiries entered and tracked weekly


* Number of quotations prepared and sent


* Quotation\-to\-order follow\-up completion rate


* Number of overdue follow\-ups


* Average quotation turnaround time


* Number of completion certificates collected


* Pending payment follow\-up ageing


* Number of customer documents pending


* Agency deliverables completed on time


* CRM/Excel/ERP update accuracy percentage


**Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) \& Measurement**
--------------------------------------------------


### **Enquiry tracking discipline**


**Measurement:** 100% of enquiries entered within 24 hours


### **Quotation turnaround**


**Measurement:** Standard quotes sent within agreed TAT


### **Follow\-up discipline**


**Measurement:** No follow\-up overdue beyond 48 hours


### **Documentation accuracy**


**Measurement:** PO/PI/quotation errors below defined tolerance
